newsitem.title: USA: NN Ball sees negatives in 1997.
newsitem.headline: NN Ball sees negatives in 1997.

text.p: NN Ball & Roller Inc said on Thursday that it expects to be hurt through the end of 1997 by some of the negative factors surrounding the second half of 1996.
NN Ball reported fourth quarter earnings of $0.17 a share, compared to $0.21 a share the previous fourth quarter.

The company said that its export sales in the last half of the year were hurt by weak international economies, excess inventories of some customers and a slowing in the rate of outsourcing captive production.

NN Ball said that two major customers plan to bring in-house a portion of their business that was previously outsourced to NN, which should be partially offset by additional business with existing customers.
The company said that it expects international sales to continue to be weak in 1997.
"1997 will be a transitional year for the company as we adjust to the slower business conditions and the decline in market share to captive producers," NN said in a press release.
The company said that it is investing in expansion of its product line and improvements in its proprietary manufacturing processes and product quality.
A company spokesman told Reuters that NN Ball plans to increase market share to non-captive producers.
A captive producer is a company that can make products supplied in-house.
